div.div:
Why the witness counts as a second reading
The AI reads pixels. The witness reads the PDF's content stream, or Google's OCR for scans. They fail in different ways, so agreement means something. A white-out edit (new value drawn over the old one) makes them disagree: that disagreement is itself a signal.
